# Copilot Instructions for Mo Music

## Project Overview

Mo Music is a cross-platform music player built with Flutter. Arabic is the default language and RTL is first-class. Updates are published from `if12is/Mo-Music`, not the original upstream repository.

The internal Dart package name remains `estrella_music` to avoid a breaking import rewrite. User-facing identity is Mo Music / مو ميوزك.

## Technology Stack

- Flutter 3.x · Dart SDK >=3.1.5 <4.0.0
- GetX
- just_audio / media_kit
- Hive + SQLite
- Google Fonts: Cairo
- Joss Red for optional identity, EMusic for optional music sync

## Identity

- App name: Mo Music
- Arabic name: مو ميوزك
- Brand color: #3332CE
- GitHub: https://github.com/if12is/Mo-Music
- Update artifacts: MoMusic-*
- Default locale: ar
